items.title: Three equivalent conditions for the diagonal of a morphism of algebraic stacks to be representable

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives three equivalent formulations of the representability condition on the diagonal of a morphism of algebraic stacks (author lemma at source lines 404-416, label lemma-properties-diagonal-representable). The proof (source lines 418-449) notes that the diagonal is always representable by algebraic spaces so that two of the formulations coincide, and identifies the pullback of the diagonal along a test morphism with an isomorphism space, which turns the monomorphism condition into the corresponding condition on that space (proof lines 418-448). The identification of the pullback with the isomorphism space is the substance. H3.
